title: Creative Systems Archive
purpose: Preserve conversation-developed games, simulations, music directions, comedic systems and media experiments as a distinct creative branch rather than mixing them into theology or empirical world data, while also recording what each work is structurally able to model.
principle: Creative works can reuse Potatoverse symbols without automatically becoming doctrinal canon. A work may nevertheless function as a simulation, compression device or experiment that makes a relationship easier to see.

projects.title: Potato of Life Growth Game
projects.core_loop: Grow one potato toward perfection, breed offspring, sell selected potatoes for resources, improve genetics and repeat across generations.
projects.tone: funny Tim/Potato of Life comments and memories integrated into play

projects.title: Tim Dooley Trading Game
projects.relation: Connects Potato humor and market systems thinking without being an economic-data source.

projects.title: Self-Playing AI Potato Town
projects.premise: A self-playing town with God/Tim on a couch, Son at the Door, autonomous agents and accelerated seasons.
projects.time_model: 1 minute of play can represent approximately one month in-world
analytical_value: how small rules generate larger stories

projects.title: Dog House Surveillance Game-Show Fiction
projects.premise: A rich Tim Dooley places chaotic dogs in an empty monitored house while an internet audience votes on increasingly absurd tasks and resource games.
projects.tone: surreal, cruel-comedy parody of livestream/game-show culture; treat as fiction, not real-world instruction

projects.title: Dense Potatoverse Poetry
projects.form: long unbroken symbolic compression, often avoiding periods and conventional pauses
analytical_value: testing which motifs remain coherent when densely coupled

projects.title: Sermon / Comedy / Speech Hybrid
projects.function: Use mythic Potato language, absurdity and institutional critique in a voice that can shift between sermon, rant, comedy and systems analysis.
analytical_value: how humor changes access to difficult material

cross_work_patterns.iteration: Growth games and simulations make recurrence visible rather than merely describing it.
cross_work_patterns.compressed_time: Accelerated seasons and generational loops make long-term consequences observable in a short session.
cross_work_patterns.observer_problem: Town and surveillance concepts repeatedly ask what changes when an observer can watch a whole system while individual agents remain inside it.
cross_work_patterns.attention_as_mechanism: Trading interfaces, livestream satire and performance forms all model attention as something that selects, amplifies and values events.
cross_work_patterns.symbol_to_system: Creative works provide a place where a symbol such as Door, Potato, Garden or Swamp can be tested as a rule or interaction rather than only interpreted as an image.

music_aesthetics.electronic_reference: dubstep lineage such as Mt Eden is preferred over generic trap when looking for heavy emotional bass music
music_aesthetics.composition_preferences: Natural cadence matters; forced or obvious rhyme is disliked. Rhythm, narrative pressure and tonal coherence should lead the writing.

archive_rule: Keep prototypes, specifications, lyrics/prompts, visual concepts and finished works linked by project ID so creative evolution can be reconstructed later.
separation_rule: MYTH may inspire WORK, but WORK does not automatically become MYTH or evidence. Simulation results describe the rules of the simulation unless separately validated against the world.
